Date 21/7/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
21st July 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
Admiral Li Ting Sing 李鼎新 and other high naval officers entertained Dr. Sun Yat Sen, Tang Shao Yi, Dr. Wu Ting Fang, Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕永建, Wen Tsung Yao 溫宗堯 He Hai Ming 何海鳴, Tsang The Yien 章太炎, Pah Wung Wen 柏文蔚 and a few others to tiffin in the Palace Hotel on the 20th instant. At the tiffin Admiral Li announced that he would resign from the navy when a man came from Peking to take his place.

It is reported that the naval officers will entertain the M. P's at the International Institute on 22nd inst.

A society called Tsoong Wha Yah Tse Koh Wen Deu 中華協贊國會團 has been organized under the auspices of the Kuomintang Party. The offices of the new society are at No. 19 San Shing Li 三新里 in the western part of Frenchtown. It has been organized for the purpose of giving moral support to Parliament in its campaign against the monarchists.

The Ching Sing 金星 Life Insurance Co and the Nanyang Bros Tobacco Co entertained the parliamentarians to tea in the Chang Su Ho garden yesterday afternoon. Tang Shao Yi was in the chair. Speeches were made by Wong Tsung Ding 王正廷 Wong Vung Thien 王文典 Woo Ching Li 吳景濂 and Sun Yat Sen. The speakers dwelt on the industrial development of China and said that parliament should assist the merchants in promoting the trade of the country. Two German gentlemen and four ladies were amongst those present.

General Yang has told the newspapers that there is no truth in their reports regarding the movements of troops.

Huang Hsin is indisposed at present.

Your obedient servant,
mmmmmmushing
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事偵緝處
I. C. DSG
466
日期 1916年7月21日
上海工部局。
1916年7月21日

（印章：上海工部局警務處）
警務處，
（偵探科）

先生：

海軍上將李鼎新及其他海軍高級軍官於本月20日在匯中飯店（Palace Hotel）設午宴招待孫逸仙博士、唐紹儀、伍廷芳博士、鈕永建、溫宗堯、何海鳴、章太炎、柏文蔚及其他數人。席間，李上將宣佈，待北京派人接替其職務後，他將辭去海軍職位。

據報，海軍軍官將於本月22日在萬國商團公會（International Institute）宴請國會議員。

一個名為「中華協贊國會團」的社團已在國民黨的支持下成立。該新社團的辦事處位於法租界西部的三新里19號。其成立宗旨是在國會反對君主派分子的運動中給予道義支持。

金星人壽保險公司與南洋兄弟菸草公司昨日下午在張園（Chang Su Ho garden）設茶會招待國會議員。唐紹儀擔任主席。王正廷、王文典、吳景濂及孫逸仙發表了演講。演講者著重論述了中國的工業發展，並稱國會應協助商人促進國家貿易。出席者中有兩位德國紳士和四位女士。

楊將軍已告知報界，有關軍隊調動的報道不實。

黃興目前身體不適。

您忠實的僕人，
mmmmmmushing
總探長

警務處總監
